integrity: Symbolic proof of all-radius formula and inverse coefficients; numerical checks are finite corroboration, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Curvature -1, complete two-dimensional cone, total angle strictly between zero and pi, marked center not the apex. Neither later regularity changes nor noisy inversion or general cone surfaces are classified. Historical priority is qualified.
title: Exact ball-volume growth and inverse rigidity on a hyperbolic cone
